governance.note: Baseline summary values were inspected before the retrospective design was written; this result is synthesis, not preregistered validation.

bounded_conclusions: For the frozen B1/B2/B4 real-Richards evidence, u_A is locally a finite-window whole-column storage sensitivity because J_S/u_A remains within roughly 3e-5 of unity.
The same accepted corrector evidence gives J_R approximately -u_A, so storage sensitivity and bottom-outward exchange sensitivity remain equal and opposite in this drainage-free family.
u_A depends strongly on coupling-window duration: increasing the window by 10x increases u_A by about 7.89x from B1 to B2 and 4.43x from B2 to B4.
Consequently u_A/dt decreases from about 0.3403/day to 0.2686/day to 0.1190/day across B1/B2/B4.

This window dependence is incompatible with treating u_A as a universal time-independent specific yield. It is consistent with transient penetration of a prescribed terminal-head perturbation through the SWAP column.

The scale ratios u_A/Sy are recorded only descriptively. They do not establish shared-volume partition or duplicate storage because the F-GC45 MODFLOW Sy and SWAP finite-window response are not yet proven to represent the same physical volume and constitutive storage relation.
